items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I used to play there with Abbie and Howard in Malden.

ctx.x: They built the front place out there. They got all the, oh you mean the patio? Yeah. Yeah, I used to go there and talk. This guy had a bar room there, I used to play there with Abbie and Howard in Malden. We used to play there on Sundays and different things. Then they built that other place out there where I had left then and I went on downtown, I started working with Boybanks and Al was what you call them.
What about Napoleon and Chappatoulas did you ever play that?
